_comment: Prototype SIF-potential assessment rules. Decision support only; NOT accident prediction. These are prototype thresholds subject to OIL-data calibration.

high.label: High SIF Potential
high.description: High hazardous energy + failed/absent/not-verified barrier + serious exposure indicators.

medium.label: Medium SIF Potential
medium.description: Moderate energy or partially effective barrier.

low.label: Low SIF Potential
low.description: Verified barrier / benign exposure / no failure indicators.

needs_review.label: Needs HSE Review
needs_review.description: Insufficient or conflicting evidence to classify.

logic._comment: combined_score = energy_rank + exposure_rank. barrier_penalty adds 2 per failure-type state.
